title: Projective Infinities and b-Calculus
summary: For a manifold $\overline{M}$ with boundary $\partial M$ and interior $M$, we introduce and study a weakening of the concept of projective compactness for torsion-free linear connections on $M$, which we call projective pre-compactness. Via the Levi-Civita connection, this concept applies to pseudo-Riemannian metrics on $M$. This is motivated by scattering theory and general relativity (GR), via asymptotic forms of metrics used in these areas.
